name: erp
description: Zoho-style ERP: Inventory, Planning, Manufacturing (React + Express + PostgreSQL/Supabase)

scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web "npm start --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run build && npm test
